# Relimie

> Relimie is a mindful drinking and alcohol tracking app for iPhone and Android. It works as a free drinking diary and alcohol calendar (calculating exact grams of pure alcohol from ml and % ABV) paired with a craving, trigger and consequence journal, helping moderate and sober-curious drinkers track consumption against a personal baseline, spot recurring triggers, estimate blood alcohol (promille), take on step-by-step challenges, and ride out cravings with a guided 4-7-8 breathing exercise — without guilt, rigid rules, accounts, or cloud storage.

The core method is "baseline-drinking": a personal long-term average in grams of pure alcohol per day rather than a rigid daily limit. The Orb on the Home Screen shows at a glance whether the user is within their baseline (Green), approaching it (Gold), or needs alcohol-free days to bring the average back down (Red).

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://relimie.com/en/): What the app is, who it's for, and how the Personal Baseline method works.
- [User Guide](https://relimie.com/en/guide.html): Complete feature documentation covering the Personal Baseline, drink & sober-day logging, blood alcohol estimate, journal & tags, Cravings Breaker, Challenges & Town, Analytics Hub, and PDF/JSON data export.
- [How to Keep a Drinking Diary & Alcohol Calendar](https://relimie.com/en/drinking-diary.html): Practical guide to keeping a drinking diary, converting drinks into grams of pure alcohol, reading weekly patterns, and downloading a free Excel template ([EN](https://relimie.com/assets/downloads/Relimie_Drinking_Diary_Template.xlsx), [DE](https://relimie.com/assets/downloads/Relimie_Trinktagebuch_Vorlage.xlsx), [RU](https://relimie.com/assets/downloads/Relimie_Dnevnik_Alkogolya_Shablon.xlsx)).
- [Alcohol Cravings: Spot Your Triggers & Consequences](https://relimie.com/en/craving-journal.html): How to keep a companion journal for the "why" behind drinking — acute cravings, drinking days, morning-after consequences, and concrete if-then plans.
- [Promille / Blood Alcohol Calculator](https://relimie.com/en/promille-calculator.html): Interactive blood alcohol calculator and a full explanation of the Widmark formula, including how long alcohol takes to clear and how accurate such an estimate really is.
- [Cravings Breaker](https://relimie.com/en/cravings.html): How the 4-7-8 breathing circuit breaker and Body Recovery Timeline work during an urge to drink.
- [FAQ](https://relimie.com/en/faq.html): Common questions about baseline tracking, logging, the Cravings Breaker, and data privacy.
- [What's New](https://relimie.com/en/whats_new.html): Cumulative release notes, newest first. Latest release v2.3.0 — personal challenges that build your own little town, full-text diary search across notes/tags/drinks, drink-type filters, and live sober-streak backgrounds; available on both iOS and Android.
- [Privacy Policy](https://relimie.com/en/privacy.html): Full data privacy documentation. All data is stored locally on device only.
- [Support](https://relimie.com/en/support.html): Contact information for support.

## Articles

Judgement-free, informational guides on mindful drinking. Each targets a common question and is a top-of-funnel entry point (also available in German at `/de/` and Russian at `/ru/`).

- [How to Keep a Drinking Diary & Alcohol Calendar](https://relimie.com/en/drinking-diary.html): How to keep a daily drinking diary and alcohol calendar (including explicit alcohol-free days), convert drinks into grams of pure alcohol (`ml × % ABV ÷ 100 × 0.8`), read a filled-in example week (143 g across seven days), download a free formula-ready Excel template (`Relimie_Drinking_Diary_Template.xlsx` / `Relimie_Trinktagebuch_Vorlage.xlsx` / `Relimie_Dnevnik_Alkogolya_Shablon.xlsx`), and compare tracking on paper, in a spreadsheet, or on the phone with Relimie.
- [Alcohol Cravings: Spot Your Triggers & Consequences](https://relimie.com/en/craving-journal.html): Companion to the drinking diary focused on the "why" behind drinking: what to jot down during an acute craving wave, on a drinking day, and the morning after, plus how to turn recurring triggers into concrete if-then plans and use Relimie's Journal tags, Habits analytics, and free 4-7-8 breathing exercise.
- [Sober After Vacation: How Many Sober Days Bring You Back?](https://relimie.com/en/sober-after-vacation.html): What a week of all-inclusive drinking adds up to in grams of pure alcohol, and how to turn it into a finish line. Works the sum through: ~110 g/day across seven nights is ~770 g against a 20 g/day baseline, leaving ~630 g above the line and about 32 sober days to bring the average back. Covers backfilling a trip roughly rather than perfectly, three ways to run it as a challenge (your exact number, a round thirty days, or a calendar month such as October), and states plainly that the days-to-baseline figure is arithmetic on the user's own logged inputs, not a health timeline.
- [Promille Calculator: Blood Alcohol and How Long Until You're Sober](https://relimie.com/en/promille-calculator.html): An interactive blood alcohol calculator plus a full explanation of the Widmark formula (c = A / (m x r), r = 0.7 male / 0.6 female / 0.65 unspecified, elimination 0.15 permille per hour). Covers converting drinks to grams of pure alcohol, why nothing speeds up sobering up, and an honest account of accuracy: the estimate deliberately errs toward a higher value and a longer wait (no absorption correction, whole day counted at once, durations rounded up, body weight never guessed). Explicitly not a fitness-to-drive test.
- [Am I Drinking Too Much?](https://relimie.com/en/am-i-drinking-too-much.html): How to tell where you stand by comparing your own long-term average against average daily alcohol intake by country and national low-risk guidelines. Explains why a single day cannot be compared to an average.
- [How Many Calories Are in Alcohol?](https://relimie.com/en/calories-in-alcohol.html): Calories in wine, beer and spirits compared, why alcohol calories add up, and how to track them without giving up the glass you enjoy.
- [All articles](https://relimie.com/en/articles.html): The full mindful-drinking article hub.

## App Details

- Platform: iOS (Apple App Store, App ID: 6759795714) and Android (Google Play, package com.ikaengel.relimie)
- Download (iOS): https://apps.apple.com/us/app/relimie-track-alcohol-limits/id6759795714
- Download (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ikaengel.relimie
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@RelimieApp
- Languages: English, German, Russian
- Current version: 2.3.0
- Privacy model: Zero cloud storage, no third-party analytics, no cookies, no account required
- Pricing: Free core features (unlimited catalogue drink & sober-day logging, Consumption Diary & Overview, Personal Baseline, blood alcohol estimate, 4-7-8 Cravings Breaker, and basic challenges); optional Relimie Premium subscription or lifetime purchase after the trial period for new Journal notes/tags, Habits & deeper trends analytics, baseline challenges, live backgrounds, and PDF report export

## Core Features

- **Drinking Diary & Alcohol Calendar**: Log drinks from a built-in catalogue (with AI lookup for unknown drinks) and mark alcohol-free days on the Orb. Automatically converts ml and % ABV into grams of pure alcohol, calories, and spending. Full chronological Consumption Diary with search across notes, tags, and drink names.
- **Personal Baseline**: A long-term daily average in grams of pure alcohol (not a rigid daily limit) that acts as an anchor for habit change. WHO guidelines and country/gender averages help users choose their starting baseline.
- **Trigger & Consequence Journal**: Daily Journal screen adapts its prompt to the day (drinking trigger, morning-after check-in, or sober-day reflection) with contextual tags for Triggers (stress, boredom, social pressure, strong urge) and Consequences (hangover, anxiety, poor sleep, guilt), plus free-form notes for personal if-then plans.
- **Analytics Hub**: Consumption Overview, Habits (correlating tags with drinking days), Trends, Streaks, a chronological heatmap, and a landscape consumption chart. Export as PDF report or JSON backup. All data stays on device.
- **Personal Challenges & Town**: Context-aware, reachable challenges (beat your last sober period, log daily for 14 days, return to baseline, or lower your baseline by 10%) where every completed challenge builds and grows your own town.
- **Blood Alcohol Estimate**: On any day with logged drinks, calculates a conservative per mille estimate and time to clear using the Widmark formula with body weight and gender. Included in the free version; explicitly an estimate and never a fitness-to-drive test.
- **Cravings Breaker**: Long-press the Orb to start a guided 4-7-8 breathing exercise (inhale 4s, hold 7s, exhale 8s) alongside a Body Recovery Timeline and grounding quotes. Included in the free version.
